## 6. Exploratory extras (run after the verdicts were known; NOT pre-registered; no verdict reads them)

### 6.1 Speed: one run of A, original code path against the new path (dev seed 100, tuned steps)

| Stream | Steps | Original path s | New path s | Speed-up | Same final accuracy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| S2-5 | 20 | 5.9 | 2.6 | 2.3x | True |
| F-15 | 50 | 27.5 | 19.8 | 1.4x | True |
| F-30 | 50 | 98.8 | 47.3 | 2.1x | True |

Original path = `bench.run_stream` with the per-sample `PhyloMoE._predict_reference`; new path = `run_fast(eval_every="final")` with the vectorised predict. Pools whose cost is mostly evaluation (kNN, class means) gain much more.
